notes.title: 1.0.2 Graphical changes and bugfixes.
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Changes:[/b][/h1]
[list] [*] Fixed an excessive server side cleanup that could in some cases cause disconnection.
[*] Changed a ton of textures to more unique textures.
[*] Fixed a gamebreaking bug where you were constantly stalking, eh, spectating fellow players even when alive.
[*] Fixed bugs wtih the new network logic (should now no longer be resistant to this change.)
[*] Fixed a misbehaving version control (that blocks you from playing if you do not have the newest version to avoid bugs) so that it should no longer be fighting you to play even when you have the newest version.
[/list]
